descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-02 Patient List Capture · S09 Tim's scan-sheet tests: duplicate decisions in both contexts, identity rules, deselect and double tap

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U4 When a day-2 scan overlaps day 1, the app shows 'N patients are already on your list' with an 'add only the new ones' option. … (UAT TC-02; TFA-92580 AC 5; TFA-92580 How it works 4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • U1 A screenshot or photo of a patient list, sent for capture, adds the patients to the list automatically via OCR, with no manual re-typing. (UAT TC-02; TFA-92580 AC 2; TFA-92580 How it works 2-3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • U9 Runs and passes in both contexts: the Hospital capture (camera icon) and the Nursing Home 'Scan Resident List' (3.3). (UAT 3.3; TFA-92580 How it works 1) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given OCR mocked at the Convex socket (patient-list-capture.spec.ts) and the pure matching functions (api/patient-activity.spec.ts)

When Hospital: confirm a scan holding a seeded match and a same-scan duplicate, answer 'Same patient (don't add)' and 'Different — add anyway'; untick one row and click confirm twice quickly. Nursing Home: scan existing + new + conflicting rows, check the summary and settle the review row as the same resident. …

Then Hospital: each matching row asks first; 'Same' keeps one chart, 'Different' adds a second, a same-scan duplicate is asked about and added once; the two ticked rows are added once each and the unticked one is not added. Nursing Home: rows are classed In panel / New / Review; the existing resident stays and the new one is created; …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions in patient-list-capture.spec.ts and api/patient-activity.spec.ts. They cover main's per-row design and the identity rules, not the UAT's 'N patients are already on your list / add only the new ones' wording (S11, S12, S27; Q1). …

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S09 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-02.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: matrix (lane A).

UAT item: TC-02 Patient List Capture · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-02/S09

Result: passed in matrix/TC-02.results.json (lane A: the existing Playwright specs below, run on the local stack; agent-matrix.sh).

  • api/patient-activity.spec.ts [api] — scan matching reviews same-batch and contradictory identities — expected
  • patient-list-capture.spec.ts [chromium] — Nursing Home scan links existing residents, creates new ones, and replaces only Today's Visits — expected
  • patient-list-capture.spec.ts [chromium] — a physician can deselect a row and repeated confirmation adds each selected patient once — expected
  • patient-list-capture.spec.ts [chromium] — existing and same-scan duplicates require visible same-or-different decisions — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (Tim's Playwright specs): the e2e setup makes fresh accounts and seeds with an admin key, which dev does not have.. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
